motion.name: cta-lift
motion.value: translateY(-1.5px) on hover; translateY(1px) on press
motion.purpose: Primary CTA press feedback; opacity-only under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Verb-led filled CTA for run actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1.5px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline secondary actions such as Open folder or Advanced.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--foreground); background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Format Chip On
components.css: .ds-chip-on { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-on:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Format Chip Off
components.css: .ds-chip-off { background: var(--background); color: var(--muted-foreground); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border) 60%, transparent); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip-off:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-chip-off:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Settings Card
components.html:
Language

Choose the interface language.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

narrative.overview: PictoolsApp is an operate surface where the media is the page. Empty tools are a full-canvas drop zone; loaded tools are stage + plan dock + horizontal filmstrip. Chrome stays thin and calm. Accent is rare; success is silent.
keyCharacteristics: Violet primary used sparingly; mint for done only

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Primary accent appears on ≤ ~5% of the viewport; rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Mint Is Done Rule
rules.body: Secondary mint is reserved for success/done states only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Motion and tint carry state, not drop shadows.

rules.name: The System Stack Rule
rules.body: Do not add display webfonts to tool pages.

dos: Keep tool pages stage-first with filmstrip + dock
Preserve source files; force a suffix on path collision
Extend this system when adding tools
donts: Invent a second palette or loud enrichment on app pages
